item.description:
Beta release — thanks for testing.

Fixes

  • Songs picked in Apple Music now play on HomePods that had something else loaded, like an ambient sound (White Noise, Rain…). Before, the HomePod could ignore the song while the app said it was playing.
  • If a HomePod turns a song down, you now see an error with the reason instead of "Playing".
  • The Apple Music panel no longer hides the app's other windows. Clicking What's New or Settings closes it, and so does opening a window from a button in the panel.

Beta release — thanks for testing.

New

  • Detailed log. While the app is in beta it also notes what you click and each command it sends to your speakers, so a bug report shows exactly what led up to a problem. Turn it off in Settings → Troubleshooting, where "Show Log in Finder" opens the log file. It's only sent if you tick "Include diagnostics" in a report.

Fixes

  • Bug reports now include the newest part of the log. Before, long logs were cut short and missed the moment the problem happened.
  • If a song can't start, the reason is now recorded, and the app no longer says "Playing" when it couldn't send the song to a speaker.
  • The Send Feedback window fits again on macOS 27.

Beta release — thanks for testing.

New

  • ⌘M shows or hides the Apple Music side.
  • Esc closes the panel (or leaves an album page, or stops typing in search, first).

Fixes

  • Keyboard shortcuts now work as soon as you open the app from the menu bar.
